name: AI for Seniors — Safe and Confident
description: Awarded for completing and passing the AI for Seniors track: understanding AI in plain language, using voice assistants, staying connected with family, health and safety, recognising AI voice-cloning scams, online safety, and knowing when not to trust AI.

criteria.narrative: Complete all 8 lessons and their interactive labs, including a scam-call simulator, then pass a 20-question assessment at 70% or above. The assessment is taken online and is not proctored.
